title: Twinstigator Charters

services.name: Mullet Run Charters
services.desc: As a father of twins, I know what it takes to create an engaging and enjoyable fishing experience for kids, regardless of age. I also remember fishing many moons ago and I was constantly chomping at the bit to go fishing anytime and anywhere I could. I also remember being mentored by some established anglers who took the time to show me how to be a more accomplished angler. It’s time for me to pay it forward. Few things are as rewarding to me as guiding a junior - or brand new - angler to catches that will inspire our future anglers, much as I was inspired. My objective will also to have your kids forget all about their devices, social media and gaming consoles - if only for a few hours.

blurb: Welcome to TwinstiGator Charters! I am Captain Tim O'Connor and I'm here to introduce you to our amazing Southeast Florida inshore fishery!
